Every on-demand median rose 15-82% a year over the last 12 months (shortage regime) while multi-year AWS spot fell 31%/yr (H100) and 9.5%/yr (A100). Older chips rent at a premium per unit of work (A100 2.30x, H100 1.78x of B200/B300), shrinking 21%/yr and 13%/yr. Income-approach resale: H100 about 16k USD (10k-25k), A100 about 8.8k (5k-14k); published asks fall inside.
